subject: Clarify: data lifecycle SLA & backup log custody — next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@medivex.com>, Vanessa Torres <vanessa.torres@medivex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: data lifecycle questions + next steps

Hi Chris & Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate you walking us through the integration flow. I promised to capture the open items on retention and deletion so your security team can review. Short list from our side: 

- SOC 2 status and expected timeframe for Type II report (if currently in progress, any interim evidence you can share).
- Authoritative retention windows for application logs, audit/event logs, and backups (how long are backups retained by default, and what is the retention for snapshots?).
- Deletion SLA expectations: when a customer requests deletion, what is the standard window for primary data removal and for backup purges? Any documented policy?
- Ability to export audit logs or provide attestations for a given time range (format and delivery).

If you can confirm the above and point us at a compliance POC we can include on the questionnaire, that would help speed the procurement loop. I attached our current vendor security questionnaire and a short SLA summary from Redwood that explains deletion/backup options we surface to customers.

Proposed next steps: you fill the questionnaire or let us know an internal contact, and we schedule a 30-min security deep-dive next week.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf, redwood_sla_summary_v2.pdf
From: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@medivex.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: data lifecycle questions + next steps

Ben — thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers from our side to help you qualify: 

1) SOC 2: Medivex completed SOC 2 Type I in late 2025; Type II run is in progress with expected completion Q3 2026. We can provide the Type I report and our SOC 2 roadmap notes as interim evidence.

2) Logs: application and audit/event logs are retained by default for 90 days. We offer an extended-retention add-on that pushes logs to cold storage up to 2 years (configurable per tenant).

3) Backups & snapshots: daily backups retained 1 year in our managed bucket by default; snapshots are kept for 30 days unless a longer retention is requested and approved at provisioning.

4) Deletion SLA: primary data deletion requests are processed within 30 days of approved request; backups are flagged for deletion and purged within 90 days thereafter (policy is to retain for a short window for disaster recovery unless explicitly accelerated by contract).

We are happy to fill your questionnaire — can you confirm the best contact to return it to? For SOC evidence, I can attach the Type I report and our compliance roadmap if that helps.

Chris
Chris Nolan
Sr. Director, Security & Risk | Medivex Health
chris.nolan@medivex.com

Chris — great, thanks for the quick answers.

I've uploaded our questionnaire and a short mapping doc that calls out where Redwood can configure retention behavior for Dedicated and Private deployments. Links are in the Drive folder (also pasted below). If you prefer, I can return the questionnaire as a completed PDF — let us know which format your procurement/compliance team prefers.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-medivex-compliance
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345-MEDVEX-42

Two specific asks from our security review team: 
- If possible to expedite an export of the Type I SOC package (redacted as needed) so our InfoSec can get eyes on it.
- Confirmation whether backups are customer-managed or in your managed bucket (you mentioned managed bucket above — can you confirm the encryption and deletion controls in place).

Proposed follow-up: 30-min security deep-dive on Thursday 5/13 or Friday 5/14. If you share a POC, I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Prep for Medivex security deep-dive

Ben — quick internal note before you send the invite:

- Prioritize getting the Type I report PDF from Chris; that's usually sufficient to unblock procurement review for initial pilots.
- For the deletion SLA question, emphasize that Redwood can offer a configurable retention profile for Dedicated customers (we can shorten backup purge windows for contract terms if needed). That option tends to close deals faster than insisting the vendor change their default backup lifecycle.
- Priyom: after Ben's call, please draft a one-page mapping that contrasts Medivex default retention (90d logs / 1yr backups) vs Redwood Dedicated options and include an example clause we can add to an SOW.

I'll join the security deep-dive where possible. Let Ben know to propose both 5/13 and 5/14 slots so we can lock a time.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Torres <vanessa.torres@medivex.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@medivex.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: data lifecycle questions + next steps

Ben/Chris — thanks for the checklist. Quick answers and commitments from Medivex: 

- We'll return the completed questionnaire by EOD 2026-05-14.
- I'll attach the Type I SOC package (redacted) to that response for your InfoSec review.
- Backups are in our managed bucket; encryption at rest uses AES-256 with KMS-managed keys, and we can support a contractual clause to accelerate backup purge on data deletion requests (will need a 30–90 day window documented).
- For the security deep-dive, our compliance lead Anika Shah will be the POC (anika.shah@medivex.com). She can join either 5/13 10:00–10:30am PT or 5/14 9:00–9:30am PT — Ben, please pick one and send the invite.

Vanessa
